critical_findings.collapse_description: GRPO model predicts almost exclusively Neutral (class 1). Confusion matrix shows 99.79% of predictions are Neutral, regardless of true label.
critical_findings.sft_performance: Strong balanced performance across all three classes (Negative F1: 75.37%, Neutral F1: 69.44%, Positive F1: 88.77%)
critical_findings.grpo_performance: Catastrophic collapse to single class. Negative: 1 correct, 3321 predicted as Neutral. Positive: 0 correct, 3327 predicted as Neutral.
critical_findings.hypothesis: GRPO reward function may have encouraged reward hacking - model learned to predict most common/safest class rather than proper sentiment classification.

thesis_implications.conclusion: GRPO training on this checkpoint led to severe reward hacking, resulting in class collapse. SFT model shows robust multi-class classification on 10k scale, validating thesis claims about supervised fine-tuning effectiveness.
thesis_implications.recommendation: Investigate GRPO reward function design - may need to penalize class imbalance or use class-weighted rewards to prevent collapse.
